strips.title: Black Friday or Cyber Monday — in real life

panels.head: Now — the numbers
panels.text: Write one price per item. The mixer under $300, the earbuds under $180. A number beats a date.

panels.head: Nov 27 — appliances
panels.text: Mixer, spot cleaner, air fryer: check Black Friday first. Buy at or under the number.

panels.head: The trap
panels.text: The robot vacuum costs more than last year's sale. The cat box never moves. Skip the banner.

panels.head: Nov 30 — gadgets
panels.text: Earbuds and electronics: Cyber Monday. Then keep every receipt until January.
